Install t3code-nightly on Omarchy

Open-source control plane for coding agents (nightly)

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add t3code-nightly-bin
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.1.1_nightly.20261020.3411-1:
    pacman -Qi t3code-nightly-bin

Open and use t3code-nightly

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

Frequently asked questions

How do I install t3code-nightly on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add t3code-nightly-bin. The download is 168.1 MB and it takes 456.3 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is t3code-nightly free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall t3code-nightly?

Run omarchy pkg drop t3code-nightly-bin. It removes the package from your system.

What does t3code-nightly depend on?

The package declares 26 dependencies: alsa-lib, at-spi2-core, cairo, dbus, expat, gcc-libs, glib2, glibc, gtk3, hicolor-icon-theme, libcups, libnotify and more. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is t3code-nightly in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as t3code-nightly-bin (version 0.1.1_nightly.20261020.3411-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Ping.gg makes it. Project site: https://t3.codes.
